title: Failure Signal Atelier and Alarm Tuning for Inference Pipelines
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a modular 'Signal Atelier' service that ingests traces, metrics, and logs and synthesizes contextual failure facets for the inference platform. The Atelier will: (1) classify failures into canonical categories (timeout: client/model/infra, overload: queue/gpu-saturation, model-error: OOM/invalid-output/zero-grad, protocol: HTTP/gRPC codes), (2) attach blame-weight attribution (model/runtime/network) and waterfall timing slices, (3) surface aggregated views to the Console dashboards and the SLO alarm tuning engine. This ticket covers schema design, tracehook changes, enrichment pipeline, initial dashboard panels, and alarm tuning rules for high-frequency/low-latency inference paths.
acceptance_criteria: Signal Atelier schema defined and documented in Confluence with examples for each failure class
Tracehook instrumentation PR merged that attaches standardized failure tags (failure.class, failure.subclass, failure.stage, blame_score) to spans
Enrichment pipeline implemented as a k8s service with streaming adapters that joins trace spans to metrics and recent logs (via trace_id) and produces failure facets to the observability store
Console dashboard panels added: Blameboard waterfall, Failure facet distribution (by model/route/region), Latency-exposure treemap, and Top contributing spans for P99 requests
Initial alarm rules deployed that reduce noisy paging by using facet-based aggregation and adaptive thresholds (canary for 72h)
Performance: enrichment adds <12ms median overhead to span processing and scales to 5k facets/sec in staging
comments: 2026-03-06 - Aisha Patel: Kickoff done with PM and Observability team. We agreed on 6 canonical failure classes and a blame_score float between 0-1. Next: schema draft and tracehook prototype.

2026-03-10 - SRE Review (Liam O'Neill): Recommended conservative sampling for model-error facets to avoid high-cardinality explosion; proposed using deterministic sample keys based on model-version + error-type.

2026-03-11 - Daniel Kim: Prototype tracehook PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/tracehooks/pull/412 — attaches failure.class and failure.stage. Unit tests added for gRPC code mapping and model error parsing.

2026-03-12 - Product (Riley Chen): Confirmed Dashboard layout and that PM will own the UX copy. Requested example datasets for customer-facing docs. Added 'customer_impact' tag for high-severity routes.

2026-03-13 - Daniel Kim: Merged enrichment service into staging with feature flag. Dashboard panels created at https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/failure-atelier. Running 72h canary of alarm rules starting 2026-03-14.
2026-03-13 - Blocker noted by Daniel: Need retention policy decision for failure facets (raw facets can be high-volume). Opening follow-up ENG ticket for compaction/rollup plan.
notes: Implementation decisions: we prioritize low-cardinality canonical tags and push high-cardinality details into a sampled 'error_samples' store. Alarm tuning will use facet rollups (per-model-version, per-region) with dynamic baselining. Follow-up tickets planned for compaction and retention policy.
